summary: Frontend-only verification of LIMPAR scoreboard reset bug fix in SinaisTab.jsx (line 104: setScores({}) added when giros.length === 0). All 5 scenarios PASSED in a single browser session.
critical_code_review_comments: SinaisTab.jsx line 104: fix is correct - when giros becomes empty (via LIMPAR/undo-to-empty), both signals and scores are reset. Confirmed working.

Note: LIMPAR only resets when giros transitions from non-empty to empty. If user clicks LIMPAR when already empty, prevGirosKeyRef guard (same key) short-circuits before line 104. Not observed as a problem in this test but worth noting: if scores somehow ended up non-zero with giros already empty (e.g. cross-tab race), a subsequent LIMPAR wouldn't clear them. Very low risk.

sessionStorage 'gatilho_scores' still retains stale keys for deleted strategies (carried from previous iterations); totalScore sums across all keys - not caught by LIMPAR reset either because it just writes {} which is fine for the fresh case.
